div.p: Separation of concerns, enforced architecturally, not by policy: a profile's credentials and MCP tools are resolved from its own scope and never unioned into a shared environment (Hermes' own guarantee). gm_cyberpunk_rpg can never reach the calendar tool because it's not listed in gm_cyberpunk_rpg's config — not because something blocks it.
Adding a new agent = new Discord bot app (manual) + new Key Vault secret + new ExternalSecret + new profile config/SOUL + own gateway process (hermes profile use <name> && hermes gateway start).
Dashed = not built yet, shown to illustrate the pattern.

Memory is the one shared backend: all three live agents point at the same Hindsight service (NAS, docker-compose), but each uses its own bank_id (hermes-<profile>) — recall never crosses banks, so this doesn't violate the isolation model above.

text.tspan: no other profile has this scope)
